TENANCY AGREEMENT
租 約
Ref: LPFO/L/2024/12A
THIS AGREEMENT is made on 20 Nov 2023
BETWEEN
(1)  LANTAU PEAK FAMILY OFFICE LTD (大嶼峰家族辦公室有限公司), BR No. 74120583, for and
on behalf of the trustee of the Cheung Family Trust, whose registered office is at Suite 3802,
38/F, Harbour Crest Tower, 1 Harbour View Street, Central, Hong Kong (the "Landlord"); and
(2)  HALCYON RE ASIA LTD, BR No. 21874460, whose registered office is at 27/F, Quarry Bay
Exchange, 979 King's Road, Quarry Bay, Hong Kong (the "Tenant").
IT IS AGREED as follows:
1.  PREMISES
1.1
The Landlord lets and the Tenant takes Flat 12A, 12/F, Seaview Court, 38 Repulse Bay
Road, Repulse Bay, Hong Kong with a saleable area of approximately 2,150 sq. ft. and one
car parking space (the "Premises").
1.2
The Premises shall be used as a private residence only.
2.  TERM
2.1
The term is 3 years from 1 Jan 2024 to 31 Dec 2026, both days inclusive (the "Term").
3.  DEPOSIT AND TENANT'S OBLIGATIONS
3.1
The Tenant shall pay a security deposit of HK$285,000 on signing, refundable without
interest on expiry.
3.2
The Tenant shall keep the interior of the Premises and the Landlord's fixtures and fittings
in good and tenantable repair.
3.3
The Tenant shall not assign, sublet or part with possession of the Premises.
3.4
The Tenant shall use the Premises as a private residence for its nominated executive and
family only.
3.5
The Landlord shall keep the main structure, roof and exterior walls in proper repair.
Tenancy Agreement LPFO/L/2024/12A  ·  Page 1 of 2

4.  RENT
4.1
The monthly rent shall be HK$95,000 (Hong Kong Dollars Ninety-Five Thousand)
inclusive of management fees and exclusive of rates, fixed for the whole Term.
4.2
No rent review shall take place during the Term.
5.  PAYMENT AND RATES
5.1
Rent is payable monthly in advance on the first day of each month by transfer to the
Landlord's account with Victoria Harbour Bank Limited, a/c 088-517-22046-8.
5.2
Government rates are payable by the Tenant.
6.  GOVERNING LAW
6.1
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
IN WITNESS whereof the parties have signed this Agreement on the date first written above.
SIGNED by the Landlord
Victoria Cheung, Director, for and on behalf of
Lantau Peak Family Office Ltd
SIGNED by the Tenant
Daniel Fong, Managing Director, for and on behalf of
Halcyon Re Asia Ltd
大嶼峰家族辦公室有限公司
★
LANDLORD
Witness: Grace Lam, Fund Accountant, Lantau Peak Family Office Ltd
